target: 10000 Selected Problems in Sciences: Mathematics, book pp.64-65 (PDF 80-81), finite-completion chapter, Question 1 only
lean_statement_scope: The exact quantified proposition ShorCompletion.HasFiniteCompletion type-checks. Neither it nor its negation is proved.

lean_theorem_roots.name: ShorArithmetic.exists_unit_eight_mul_eq_four
lean_theorem_roots.statement: For every natural n with 4 | n and not 8 | n, there is u with gcd(u,n)=1 and 8u mod n = 4 mod n.
lean_theorem_roots.scope: Arithmetic step of the 8 | n proof. Partial: the code-theoretic bridge and Lemma U are written proofs, not formalized.

lean_theorem_roots.name: ShorArithmetic.quotient_ge_sixty
lean_theorem_roots.statement: If q>0, 4 | q, and p*r*t | q for pairwise distinct primes p,r,t (allowed to be 2,3,5 or 11), then q >= 60.
lean_theorem_roots.scope: Exact quotient condition requested by parent; arithmetic only.
lean_theorem_roots.assumptions: Exactly the displayed hypotheses; no assumption that the primes avoid the divisors of 330.

lean_theorem_roots.name: ShorArithmetic.combined_order_lower_bound
lean_theorem_roots.statement: If n>0, 8 | n, and 330*p*r*t | n for pairwise distinct primes p,r,t, then n >= 19800.
lean_theorem_roots.scope: Conditional arithmetic corollary. Szabo 2006 Theorem 7 (unverified source) and 8 | n (written proof) are hypotheses, not formalized.
lean_theorem_roots.novelty: The arithmetic is elementary; novelty of the resulting n>=19800 corollary is unaudited.

lean_controls: Four proven negations/examples in the same file: dropping 8 | n is false (n=9900); hypotheses are satisfiable at n=19800; dropping distinctness is false (q=4); dropping not-8|n can make the unit impossible (n=8).

claims.statement: The exact 16-word C is uniquely decipherable, has maximum length 15, and is not complete; bbaab and a^26 are not factors of C*.
claims.label: Certification (finite)
claims.verification: work/check_evidence.py: two UD algorithms, factor automaton, mutation and positive controls.

claims.statement: For any finite UD complete M containing C, with a^n in M: (R,L) factor Z_n, Y=C_M(b) has n elements, and R x Y^t x L tiles Z_n^(t+1) for every t>=0 (proof.md section 3).
claims.label: Written proof; t=0 is the Restivo-Salemi-Sportelli lemma.
claims.verification: Codex snapshot review; replayed up to t=3 on five explicit maximal codes (evidence/bridge-multiplier-sanity.json).
claims.novelty: Not claimed; related to Cordero 2023 borders and De Felice companion factorizations.

claims.statement: Nonnegative convolution identities F*B=1 are preserved under pushforward of B by multipliers coprime to the total mass of B.
claims.label: Written proof of a classical multiplier argument.

claims.statement: If P X1...Xt Q tiles for all products from a family, then so do products after one-sided multiplication of a member by a unit modulo n.
claims.label: Written proof; special case of Cordero 2023 Theorem 7.2 proved independently.

claims.statement: Every hypothetical completion has 330 | |R|, 2 | |L|, hence 660 | n.
claims.label: Written proof.
claims.novelty: 330 | |R| and n=330k, k>=4 are Cordero 2019 prior art; the 2 | |L| collision is unestablished as novel.
